name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Thun- derous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Fog Cloud.

actions.name: Thunderous Mace
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Thundercloud
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 240 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

actions.name: At Will
actions.text: Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Gaseous Form, Telekinesis Bonus Actions

actions.name: Misty Step
actions.text: The giant casts the Misty Step spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Cockatrice Cockatrice

traits.name: Training
traits.text: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the GM’s choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.
